verdict.rationale: Founders Workbench publishes formation guidance on choosing between corporations and LLCs. Its Document Driver generates Delaware C-Corp or LLC formation documents, so entity-type guidance exists, but only for the US/Delaware context. Goodwin has offices in London and Munich, but no published guidance compares jurisdictions or covers non-US entity types. Missing for 10: guidance on UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG, or Indian Pvt Ltd; market-based advice on choosing a jurisdiction; independent corroboration.
